sources.author: Audiokinetic
sources.title: Wwise Gyms — BasicLocalizedVoice
claims: Caller creates a one-entry bankToReload list using WwiseObjectReference.DisplayName.
Coroutine or Task waits on SetLanguageAndReloadLocalizedBanks; with both Addressables symbols, waits on CompleteLoadBank before posting the event.
limits: Only caller-side order inspected; manager internals, all-bank behavior and SDK-wide contracts are not established.

sources.author: Audiokinetic
sources.title: Wwise Gyms — BasicLocalizedVoiceTests
claims: Inspected test explicitly compares current language strings and PlayingId values after empty-language and fr_FR calls.
Those assertions do not directly compare emitted recording language, media identity or waveform.
limits: Do not confuse PlayingId with Event ID.
Expected PlayingId arithmetic depends on both AK_WWISE_ADDRESSABLES and UNITY_ADDRESSABLES; error expectations use !AK_WWISE_ADDRESSABLES.
A hypothetical wrong-language recording is not proven to pass the complete test, other logs/framework paths may fail.
Non-WebGL SetLanguageAndWait polls Task.IsCompleted rather than awaiting/rethrowing the task result; no successful execution claimed.
